info.title: PixVerse V6 Max
info.description: Generate a 1-15 second video from text or one image, with optional native audio.

post.summary: Submit a PixVerse V6 Max video task

input.prompt: A blue glass marble rolls across a clean white table in warm morning light
Animate this product with gentle movement

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure notifications. Use a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.

input.description: Text-to-video requires prompt and omits image_urls. Image-to-video requires exactly one image_urls item and does not accept aspect_ratio.

prompt.description: Required for text-to-video, up to 5,000 characters. Optional for image-to-video, up to 2,048 characters. Cannot be blank.

image_urls.description: Exactly one public HTTP or HTTPS image URL for image-to-video. JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Do not send this field for text-to-video.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame for text-to-video. Do not send this field for image-to-video.

audio.description: Generate a native audio track. Defaults to silent video.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
